title: Projects
text:
Tools: R, Shiny, Quarto, Google Sheets API, ggplot2, statistical modeling
Built a team-facing practice performance dashboard for Virginia Tech Women’s Basketball to track hustle metrics, automate reports, and visualize player trends over time.
Public materials use anonymized or altered data to preserve team confidentiality while showing the dashboard structure, workflow, and analytical approach.
Highlights - Automated practice data ingestion from structured Google Sheets tabs - Built caching workflows to reduce API load and support scalable updates - Created coach-facing visual summaries of player trends and team-level patterns - Evaluated relationships between practice hustle metrics and subsequent game performance

Scouting Card & Badge System
Tools: R, Synergy data, ggplot2, image rendering, percentile grading
Designed an automated scouting card system that converts playtype data into team-themed player evaluation graphics.
Highlights - Built custom badge logic using playtype efficiency, usage, and percentile-based grading - Generated team-colored cards for scouting and player evaluation workflows - Combined statistical summaries with visual design to make player tendencies easier to interpret

title: Projects
text:
Shot Quality Pipeline
Tools: R, NBA Stats API, play-by-play data, shot chart data
Built a prototype shot quality pipeline using NBA Stats API play-by-play and shot chart data to model contextual shot value and offensive process metrics.
Highlights - Pulled and cleaned player-level shot events from public NBA data sources - Developed a framework for evaluating shot quality beyond makes and misses - Designed the project as a proof of concept for future tracking-data-style analysis
